This bulletin outlines the method 
 for testing the power transformer after operation of flow meter protection

Flow meter protection: 
 It operates when the oil velocity exceeds 0.9 m/sec. This occurs due to the
 presence of a hot spot inside the tape changes insulator cylinder causing
 expansion of oil and its flow through the flow meter protection device
 leading to tripping the transformer.

Tripping might be caused by overloading which indicates the
 presence of a large quantity of carbon inside the tape. Changer cylinder causing
 bad contact. 
 OR: 
 If the flow meter operates due to short circuit on the lines 132kv the short
 circuit current would depend on the distance between point of shortage
 and the transformers. In such case the valve of the short circuit current is
 too high and increases as that distance decreases.

After operation of the flow meter protection, you 
 should carry out the following procedure:

items: A work permit must be issued.

In both cases the transformer must not be switched on again unless the
 following precautions tests are taken

The transformer is entirely disconnected and the earthing took place in
 the three directions.
Worker must put on protective helmet .
A safety belt must be also put on while disconnecting the 500kv terminals.
Worker must have a comprehensive knowledge of the required job.
A safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Complete tool kit/set, including a torque wrench,

Get a press filter and close the valve between the conservator tank
 and the tape changer.
Remove the tap changer membrane at the top of the tap changer cover.

Drain the oil through the suction pipe using a transparent hose in
 order to observe the oil colour 
 of the oil withdrawn eventually you ll find that the oil turns black
 due to presence of carbon.

To clean all contacts from carbon press oil hot at 80oC down
 words using a filter press , 
 while tap changer is operated up and down.

Withdraw the oil once again observing its colour till it retrains to
 its original colour.

Restore the membrane once more to its initial position and tighten it
 carefully. Then the valve between the conservator tank and tape changer
 is reopened.

Re-detect the R.D.C at
 every step of the top changer and compare with the manufacturer
 certificate

N.B : Youll find at that the value is now the same as that in the
 certificate if not you have to make capital maintenance 
 on the tap changer and change the burned contact.

Introduction
This bulletin outlines the method 
 for testing the power transformer after operation of flow meter protection
Information
Flow meter protection: 
 It operates when the oil velocity exceeds 0.9 m/sec. This occurs due to the
 presence of a hot spot inside the tape changes insulator cylinder causing
 expansion of oil and its flow through the flow meter protection device
 leading to tripping the transformer.
Tripping might be caused by overloading which indicates the
 presence of a large quantity of carbon inside the tape. Changer cylinder causing
 bad contact. 
 OR: 
 If the flow meter operates due to short circuit on the lines 132kv the short
 circuit current would depend on the distance between point of shortage
 and the transformers. In such case the valve of the short circuit current is
 too high and increases as that distance decreases.
Recommendations
After operation of the flow meter protection, you 
 should carry out the following procedure:
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
In both cases the transformer must not be switched on again unless the
 following precautions tests are taken
The transformer is entirely disconnected and the earthing took place in
 the three directions.
Worker must put on protective helmet .
A safety belt must be also put on while disconnecting the 500kv terminals.
Worker must have a comprehensive knowledge of the required job.
A safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit/set, including a torque wrench,
Lubricating grease (light grade),
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes,
Micro Ohm tester,
Megger tester.
Work to be Carried Out
Get a press filter and close the valve between the conservator tank
 and the tape changer.
Remove the tap changer membrane at the top of the tap changer cover.
Drain the oil through the suction pipe using a transparent hose in
 order to observe the oil colour 
 of the oil withdrawn eventually you ll find that the oil turns black
 due to presence of carbon.
To clean all contacts from carbon press oil hot at 80oC down
 words using a filter press , 
 while tap changer is operated up and down.
Withdraw the oil once again observing its colour till it retrains to
 its original colour.
Restore the membrane once more to its initial position and tighten it
 carefully. Then the valve between the conservator tank and tape changer
 is reopened.
Re-detect the R.D.C at
 every step of the top changer and compare with the manufacturer
 certificate
N.B : Youll find at that the value is now the same as that in the
 certificate if not you have to make capital maintenance 
 on the tap changer and change the burned contact.
